# Repository branding checklist

Settings that live in GitHub's UI (not in files) — apply these to match the kit.

## Social preview

Upload `assets/brand/social-preview.png`:
**Settings → General → Social preview → Edit → Upload an image**

## Repository description

> Open-source environmental data management: lab and field samples, regulatory
> limits, OGC API Features, and regulator-ready exports (XLSX crosstab, WQX, AQS, EIM).

Suggested topics: `environmental-data` `lims` `postgis` `ogc-api` `geospatial`
`water-quality` `golang` `react` `maplibre` `opentelemetry` `agpl`

## Files already in the repo

| Asset | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `assets/brand/logo-mark.svg` | Icon; also copied to `ui/public/favicon.svg` |
| `assets/brand/logo-lockup.svg` | README/docs header lockup |
| `assets/brand/social-preview.png` | GitHub social preview (1280×640) |
| `assets/brand/README.md` | Palette, type, voice, usage rules |
| `assets/screenshots/*.png` | README screenshots |

The web app also sets `theme-color`, favicon, and Open Graph tags in
`ui/index.html`.
